| **Phone / tablet** | ❌ Not supported | See below |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Layering principle (why the code lives where it does)"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **Pure logic separated from wiring**: validating incoming data, generating the approval copy shown"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" to the user, encoding bytes, parsing frame numbers and combining cross-frame snapshots — these are "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"pure, so they live in unit-testable modules (`background/tools.ts` for dispatch and frame routing, `"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"background/authorization.ts`, `background/frames.ts`, `background/image-fetch.ts`). The wiring stays"},{"id":"p18s5","text":" in `background/index.ts`.
- **The composition root is testable too**: each spec that loads `backgro"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"und/index.ts` installs a sufficient `chrome` API stub through `vi.stubGlobal` (see the `mockChrome` "},{"id":"p18s7","text":"helper at the top of `tests/background-tools.spec.ts`), which brings the **wiring itself** under ass"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"ertions such as "every event has a listener", "content-ready gets a reply" and "ports that are not t"},{"id":"p18s9","text":"he panel are ignored".
- **Types and guards from one source**: `tabSwitch` is parsed by `isTabSwitch"},{"id":"p18s10","text":"Mode` exported next to the `TabSwitchMode` union in `background/tab-affinity.ts`, and every stored s"},{"id":"p18s11","text":"etting is normalized through one `normalizeSettings` in `settings.ts` against `SETTINGS_DEFAULTS` — "},{"id":"p18s12","text":"so adding a panel control but forgetting to teach the background to accept it is a bug the parser sh"},{"id":"p18s13","text":"ows up rather than a silent no-op.
- **Cost guarantees can be verified**: `visionThinking: off` cann"},{"id":"p18s14","text":"ot be proven to take effect from the request body (a provider may silently ignore it), so at startup"},{"id":"p18s15","text":" it sends a single 1×1-pixel image as a self-check and **reads `usage` back**; it warns only if reas"},{"id":"p18s16","text":"oning tokens actually appear, and stays quiet otherwise (no false alarms).
- **Unused imports/parame"},{"id":"p18s17","text":"ters are errors**: `tsconfig.base.json` enables `noUnusedLocals` + `noUnusedParameters`, so this kin"},{"id":"p18s18","text":"d of rot can no longer accumulate silently.
- **No sharing of small utilities across packages**: a t"},{"id":"p18s19","text":"hree-line type guard like `isRecord` is duplicated in the protocol package and the bridge package, b"},{"id":"p18s20","text":"ecause turning the wire-protocol package into a general-purpose toolkit is not worth it.
